For reference, I'm in my late 20's, early 30's. I've never given much thought about sugar my whole life, to me it was just an ingredient for food, not unlike salt and pepper. Sure, I was familiar with the narrative that "sugar is bad for you", but I took it with a grain of salt and an "everything in moderation" attitude (of course, "moderation" was truly far from actually being moderate in my own diet). After "the sugar incident" and a second similar incident a few days later, however, I decided to cut it out my life as much as I could for good. I stopped eating candies, no more sugary drinks of any kind, no more weekend cake at church potlucks, no more mochi, haupia, or even bbq sauce. It if said "Sugar" in the ingredients, I reluctantly put it back on the shelf. That's not to say I went full retard, you just never go full retard man, but I cut 90-95% of it out of my diet

Nothing changed.

Or so I thought.

Little things started happening; firstly, I started craving waaayy more veggies. I've started eating more fruits as well, but I really crave veggies now. I can walk by a table with rows of food: chicken katsu, salmon lomi, hamburgers, tiramisu cake, fried rice, sushi, chopped fruits, fahgeetas, and a salad, and all I see, animalistically almost, is the salad. Dat leafy green with tomatoes and cucumber, damn bae!

Secondly, everything tastes better. Tastes are definitely more pronounced. I went to visit my parents house one day and stumbled upon half a watermelon on their kitchen counter. I bit into a thick slice and tasted what I thought was definitely among the top 5 sweetest and juiciest watermelons I had ever eaten. I was stuffing my face with it so fast I felt like I'd probably growl at anyone who'd come too close to me. When my parents came home and found me and what remained of the watermelon I commented on how delicious it was and asked where they got it. They looked at me like I was a retard and told me it was a crap watermelon, far too watery and barely sweet. They had planned to throw away the half that I thought was pure ambrosia!

Thirdly, I'm eating a lot less food in general. I'm just hardly ever hungry anymore, and when I am, it's a sudden and deep hunger that is fully satisfied with a single sit down meal. Let me explain. I used to, pretty much my whole life, more or less be hungry all day long. I would eat my meal until I'm 80% full, as you do, and go on feeling unsatisfied until the next meal, occasionally snacking in between meals. Now I eat breakfast, am completely satisfied, go about my day feeling great until WHAM, I realize I'm hungry again, eat lunch, feel euphoric, go about my businesses until WHAM I feel hungry again, eat dinner, feel like I own the universe, then go about my evening before falling asleep like a baby, waking up feeling great, and starting all over. I no longer snack, and my portions do seem smaller. Coincidentally, I've also been losing 1-2lbs a week for the past few weeks. Weird.

I'm not exactly "un-fit"; throughout my human career I've done weightlifting, run plenty of 5K's, even did a semester of ROTC in college, but this is the first time in my life that I feel at my peak health...and I see nothing but more peakiness ahead.

Fuck sugar, fuck it to hell and fuck the horse it road in on. That shit is the devil. Specifically table sugar. I still eat my fruits (and I live in Hawaii, I have plenty of amazing fruits to eat here) and feel awesome, but as soon as I try something with table sugar in it, man...I feel like shit after. Every. Single. Time.

Anyway, that's my story and I'm sticking to it.
